label.purpose: Mono micro-labels: stat captions, eyebrows, technical tags.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button glow, light mode only.

motion.name: ease-out-soft

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen. Chai gradient with a lift on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: .85rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; cursor: pointer; color: oklch(0.99 0.01 80); background: linear-gradient(105deg, oklch(0.74 0.14 66) 0%, oklch(0.68 0.17 54) 34%, oklch(0.62 0.19 45) 66%, oklch(0.52 0.17 38) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(1 0 0 / 30%), 0 12px 28px -14px oklch(0.62 0.19 45 / 75%); transition: transform .15s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), box-shadow .25s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.6 0.18 46); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action next to a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: .85rem; font-weight: 600; font-size: .9rem; cursor: pointer; color: oklch(0.22 0.02 50); background: oklch(0.95 0.016 78 / 75%); border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.018 75); transition: background-color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.93 0.035 68); border-color: oklch(0.8 0.06 55); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.6 0.18 46); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Sunken field that rises and glows amber on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 .95rem; border-radius: .85rem; font: inherit; font-size: .92rem; color: oklch(0.22 0.02 50); background: oklch(0.955 0.014 78 / 85%); border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.018 75); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px oklch(0.38 0.06 55 / 9%); transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .25s, background-color .2s; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.8 0.06 55); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.6 0.18 46 / 85%); background: oklch(1 0.003 80); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px oklch(0.6 0.18 46 / 18%); }

components.name: Glass Card
components.description: Level-1 container with a warm hairline and soft shadow.
components.html:
Passkeys

Sign in with a fingerprint or device.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: 1.15rem; color: oklch(0.22 0.02 50); background: oklch(0.992 0.006 80 / 80%); border: 1px solid oklch(0.89 0.018 75); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 oklch(0.22 0.02 50 / 7%), 0 24px 60px -34px oklch(0.38 0.06 55 / 28%); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: Sora, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: .875rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.5 0.022 60); }

components.name: Nav Link (active)
components.description: Sidebar row. The active item gets an amber wash and a chai bar on its left edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 42px; padding: 0 .85rem; border-radius: .8rem; font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; color: oklch(0.22 0.02 50); background: linear-gradient(90deg, oklch(0.6 0.18 46 / 16%), transparent); } .ds-nav-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 22%; bottom: 22%; width: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: linear-gradient(105deg, oklch(0.74 0.14 66), oklch(0.52 0.17 38)); }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: Small section label with an optional live dot.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .3rem .75rem; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .02em; color: oklch(0.6 0.18 46); border: 1px solid oklch(0.78 0.08 55); background: oklch(0.6 0.18 46 / 9%); } .ds-dot { width: .45rem; height: .45rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.55 0.13 152); }

narrative.overview: ChaiAuth is a record-keeper that happens to be friendly. Every screen answers a question of trust (who is signing in, what is being approved, which session is live), and answers it in a warm voice. The system pairs precise structure with the material warmth of cream paper, chai-brown ink and a single spiced accent.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutrals tinted toward amber; no pure white or pure black surfaces.
Tactile controls that lift on hover and press down on click.
Mono, uppercase micro-labels for technical facts (endpoints, status, counts).
Two distinct theme personalities that share one structure.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Masala Amber and the chai gradient are the only saturated colors on a screen. Status colors appear only when they carry status.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans toward amber (hue 50–80). Never introduce a cold gray or pure #fff/#000 surface.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Machines Rule
rules.body: Anything a developer might copy (endpoints, client IDs, codes, key prefixes) is mono. Everything else is Manrope or Sora.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers that line up or change (counts, codes, timers) use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Theme Personality Rule
rules.body: Light may glow; dark may not. Never add colored glow, blur or aurora motion to dark surfaces.

dos: Do keep every neutral tinted toward amber (hue 50–80) and use the Masala Amber accent on one primary action per screen.
Do use the 44px control height for all buttons and inputs so rows align.
Do write endpoints, IDs and codes in mono with tabular figures.
Do give dark mode its own flat treatment: hairline borders, solid fills, no blur or glow.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion: stop aurora, float, marquee and animated gradient.
donts: Don't use cold enterprise-security imagery (shields, padlocks, navy and teal, compliance-badge walls).
Don't use generic SaaS gradients, purple-blue washes or glassmorphism as decoration.
Don't use hacker-terminal tropes: neon green on black, matrix rain.
Don't spread the chai gradient beyond the CTA, the active nav indicator, avatars and one key heading word.
Don't invent customers, logos, stats or compliance badges in the interface (see PRODUCT.md).
